name: Custom clans both AI with official Japan human

steps.code: if Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() ~= 1 or Game.GetLocalPlayer() ~= 0 then error('wrong starting turn or human') end; local expected={{'LEADER_HOJO','CIVILIZATION_JAPAN',SlotStatus.SS_TAKEN},{'LEADER_JAC_ODA_NOBUHIDE','CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA',SlotStatus.SS_COMPUTER},{'LEADER_JAC_TAKEDA_NOBUTORA','CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA',SlotStatus.SS_COMPUTER}}; for i=0,2 do local c=PlayerConfigurations[i]; local e=expected[i+1]; if not c or c:GetLeaderTypeName() ~= e[1] or c:GetCivilizationTypeName() ~= e[2] or c:GetSlotStatus() ~= e[3] or not Players[i]:IsAlive() then error('wrong player or slot '..i) end end; return 'human=0 oda=1:AI takeda=2:AI'

if Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() ~= 1 then error('not turn 1') end; for _,id in ipairs({1,2}) do local n=Players[id]:GetCities():GetCount(); if n ~= 0 then error('AI '..id..' already has '..n..' cities at baseline') end; print('[JAC_BOTH_AI] phase=start player='..id..' cities='..n..' units='..Players[id]:GetUnits():GetCount()) end; return 'both AI start with zero cities'

local names={{1,'CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA','LOC_CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA_DESCRIPTION','LOC_CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA_NAME'},{2,'CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA','LOC_CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA_DESCRIPTION','LOC_CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA_NAME'}}; for _,e in ipairs(names) do local c=PlayerConfigurations[e[1]]; if c:GetCivilizationTypeName() ~= e[2] or c:GetCivilizationDescription() ~= e[3] or c:GetCivilizationShortDescription() ~= e[4] then error('wrong initial house name '..e[1]) end; print('[JAC_BOTH_AI] phase=start player='..e[1]..' house='..Locale.Lookup(c:GetCivilizationDescription())) end; local target=Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_CUSTOM_CIVS_RENAMED_NAME'); if target ~= nil then error('rename before turn 3') end; return 'both initial house names verified'

if Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() < 4 then error('house-name switch turn not passed') end; for _,id in ipairs({1,2}) do local p=Players[id]; local cities=p:GetCities(); local capital=cities:GetCapitalCity(); if not p:IsAlive() or cities:GetCount()<1 or not capital then error('AI '..id..' did not found a city') end; local plot=Map.GetPlot(capital:GetX(),capital:GetY()); PlayersVisibility[0]:ChangeVisibilityCount(plot:GetIndex(),1); print('[JAC_BOTH_AI] phase=turn4 player='..id..' cities='..cities:GetCount()..' capital='..capital:GetName()..' x='..capital:GetX()..' y='..capital:GetY()..' units='..p:GetUnits():GetCount()) end; return 'both AI founded capitals by turn '..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()

if Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()<4 then error('wrong turn') end; local target=Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_CUSTOM_CIVS_RENAMED_NAME'); if target~='LOC_JAC_TAKEDA_RENAMED_NAME' then error('rename property missing') end; local names={{1,'CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA','LOC_CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA_DESCRIPTION','LOC_CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA_NAME'},{2,'CIVILIZATION_JAC_TAKEDA',target,target}}; for _,e in ipairs(names) do local c=PlayerConfigurations[e[1]]; if c:GetCivilizationTypeName()~=e[2] or c:GetCivilizationDescription()~=e[3] or c:GetCivilizationShortDescription()~=e[4] then error('wrong switched house name '..e[1]) end; print('[JAC_BOTH_AI] phase=turn4 player='..e[1]..' house='..Locale.Lookup(c:GetCivilizationDescription())) end; return 'Oda unchanged; Takeda switched'

condition.code: for _,id in ipairs({1,2}) do local c=Players[id]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); if not c or not GetCityBanner(id,c:GetID()) then return false end end; return true

steps.code: local keys={{1,'LOC_CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA_DESCRIPTION'},{2,'LOC_JAC_TAKEDA_RENAMED_NAME'}}; for _,e in ipairs(keys) do local c=Players[e[1]]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); local b=GetCityBanner(e[1],c:GetID()); if not b or not b.m_Instance then error('missing city banner '..e[1]) end; b:UpdateName(); local tip=b.m_Instance.CityBannerButton:GetToolTipString(); if not tip or not string.find(tip,Locale.Lookup(e[2]),1,true) then error('wrong banner house '..e[1]..': '..tostring(tip)) end; print('[JAC_BOTH_AI] phase=turn4 player='..e[1]..' banner='..tip) end; return 'both city banner house names verified'
if IsBlockingInput() then OnHideAdvisorDialog() end; return not IsBlockingInput()
if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then OnClose() end; return ContextPtr:IsHidden()

if Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()<4 or Game.GetLocalPlayer()~=0 then error('wrong loaded turn or human') end; for _,id in ipairs({1,2}) do if PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetSlotStatus()~=SlotStatus.SS_COMPUTER or not Players[id]:IsAlive() or Players[id]:GetCities():GetCount()<1 then error('AI state not retained '..id) end end; return 'both AI and capitals retained at turn '..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()

local target=Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_CUSTOM_CIVS_RENAMED_NAME'); if target~='LOC_JAC_TAKEDA_RENAMED_NAME' then error('rename property lost') end; local names={{1,'LOC_CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA_DESCRIPTION','LOC_CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA_NAME'},{2,target,target}}; for _,e in ipairs(names) do local c=PlayerConfigurations[e[1]]; if c:GetCivilizationDescription()~=e[2] or c:GetCivilizationShortDescription()~=e[3] then error('loaded house mismatch '..e[1]) end; print('[JAC_BOTH_AI] phase=load player='..e[1]..' house='..Locale.Lookup(c:GetCivilizationDescription())) end; return 'both house names retained'
if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then OnClose() end; return ContextPtr:IsHidden()

if Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()<5 then error('post-load turn missing') end; for _,id in ipairs({1,2}) do local p=Players[id]; local c=p:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); if not p:IsAlive() or not c then error('AI inactive after load '..id) end; print('[JAC_BOTH_AI] phase=turn5 player='..id..' cities='..p:GetCities():GetCount()..' capital='..c:GetName()..' units='..p:GetUnits():GetCount()) end; return 'both AI active after one loaded turn'

local target=Game:GetProperty('JAC_POC_CUSTOM_CIVS_RENAMED_NAME'); if target~='LOC_JAC_TAKEDA_RENAMED_NAME' or PlayerConfigurations[1]:GetCivilizationDescription()~='LOC_CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA_DESCRIPTION' or PlayerConfigurations[2]:GetCivilizationDescription()~=target then error('post-load house names wrong') end; return 'Oda and renamed Takeda names still correct at turn '..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()
if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then OnClose() end; return ContextPtr:IsHidden()
